paper.title_en: Critical Temperatures of Excited Holographic Superconductors in Born--Infeld Electrodynamics on a Reissner--Nordström--AdS Background
paper.abstract_en: We study the ground state (GS) and the two lowest excited states (ES1, ES2) of a probe holographic superconductor with Born-Infeld (BI) electrodynamics on a charged Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS (RN-AdS) black hole background. Distinguishing these background geometries by their extended-thermodynamic pressure P=-Lambda/8pi requires the electric charge Q: the neutral Schwarzschild-AdS metric admits only one positive horizon for any M,L^2>0 and cannot support the SBH/LBH transition. Working on the correctly identified RN-AdS geometry, we set up the scalar/BI-gauge probe sector, formulate the linear eigenvalue problem for the onset of condensation, and solve it by a shooting method. We obtain T_c of GS, ES1, ES2 at three representative pressures (P>P_c, P=P_c, P<P_c) and five values of the BI parameter b in {0,1,2,3,5} Q^-1. T_c increases monotonically with P and is suppressed by b for all three states, more for the excited states (~2% for GS versus ~10-27% for ES1/ES2 at b=5 Q^-1). A finer scan in b shows the suppression follows a quadratic law T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2, with alpha(GS)~7.4e-4, alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3, alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2, consistent with the radial profiles of the threshold modes: the ground-state mode is concentrated near the horizon, while the nodal excited-state modes extend further into the bulk. We present this as a nodal-sensitivity picture rather than a proven mechanism, and make it concrete with an explicit leading-order BI correction to the bulk gauge field: this differential coupling has not previously been isolated and quantified, independently of the back-reacted problem left to a companion study. These results clarify how BI nonlinearity interacts with the nodal structure of excited states, giving a sharper linear baseline for the back-reacted, finite-temperature holographic superconductor.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文在RN-AdS背景下研究受激全息超导体中的Born-Infeld电动力学，聚焦于临界温度的节点敏感性，具有理论深度和一定的新颖性。
decision.title_zh: Born-Infeld电动力学中Reissner-Nordström-AdS背景下受激全息超导体的临界温度
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在带电Reissner-Nordstrom-AdS（RN-AdS）黑洞背景上，具有Born-Infeld（BI）电动力学的探针全息超导体的基态（GS）和两个最低激发态（ES1，ES2）。通过扩展热力学压力P=-Lambda/8pi来区分这些背景几何需要电荷Q：中性的Schwarzschild-AdS度规对于任何M，L^2>0只允许一个正视界，并且不能支持SBH/LBH转变。在正确识别的RN-AdS几何上，我们建立了标量/BI规范探针扇区，制定了凝聚开始的线性特征值问题，并通过打靶法求解。我们在三个代表性压力（P>P_c，P=P_c，P<P_c）和BI参数b的五个值（{0,1,2,3,5} Q^-1）下获得了GS、ES1、ES2的T_c。T_c随P单调增加，并被b抑制，对所有三个态都是如此，对激发态的抑制更明显（在b=5 Q^-1时，GS约2%，而ES1/ES2约10-27%）。对b的更精细扫描显示，抑制遵循二次定律T_c(b)/T_c(0)=1-alpha b^2，其中alpha(GS)~7.4e-4，alpha(ES1)~4.1e-3，alpha(ES2)~1.1e-2，与阈值模式的径向轮廓一致：基态模式集中在视界附近，而节点激发态模式进一步延伸到体内部。我们将其呈现为一个节点敏感性图像，而不是一个被证明的机制，并通过体规范场的显式领先阶BI修正使其具体化：这种微分耦合之前没有被独立地分离和量化，独立于留给同伴研究的反作用问题。这些结果阐明了BI非线性如何与激发态的节点结构相互作用，为反作用的有限温度全息超导体提供了一个更清晰的线性基线。
